component: EWS delete lookup and replay boundary

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical DeleteHeaderFromDB checks the nsresult of GetMsgHdrForEwsItemID, then passes its output straight to LocalDeleteMessages. The lookup can return NS_OK with a null output when no row exists; LocalDeleteMessages dereferences each header to read its key. This is a verified static missing-output guard, not a reproduced crash or a claimed historical failure report. The fixed Exchange OnMessageDeleted returns NS_OK when the header is already absent, because user deletion can be followed by the server’s Delete sync change. Reuse the existing shared remote-ID idempotency lesson for that current behavior. The new evidence establishes the historical unguarded boundary. No missing-header, delete-replay, runtime, build or accessibility test ran. External discussion is pending.
title: Check a nullable EWS lookup before passing its header to deletion
